Native time=open interpretation still requires actual capture qualification. Calendar1M/1w/3d not silently treated fixed milliseconds.
time_and_quality.current_OI: Rotation/stale/missing/unitunknown OI stays unqualified, no0fill/clockrefresh/notional guess; existing strategy/gates remain closed if required metric is unavailable
time_and_quality.BBO: Standalone book sample has no clock; clocked depth quote uses its OWN nativeT, not premium/last/ticker/received timestamp borrowed acrossreplies

COIN_M levels are documented contracts. Neither is automatic execution-unit qualification.
